full_judgment:
103. From the evidences of PW 2 and 3 as discilssed above it reveals that PW 2 and 3 are the employees of plaintiff PW 1. From the cross examination it transpired that both supporting PWs are in direct control of PW 1 who cannot but are obliged to support their master. However, in cross examination they have admitted and stated some facts by which they have totally destroyed credibilities of examination-in-chief given in support of their master. In the facts and circumstances as disclosed above it appears that plaintiff has failed to adduce any independent and disinterested witnesses in support of his case. Further more vital and important witness Showkat Ali was not examined by the plaintiff whereas from the bainapatra it appears that the address of defendant No. 1 Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur and witness Showkat Ali of Bainapatra are same. Both of them used to live in the same holding of Mirpur. Neither in the plaint nor in the deposition of PW 1 it has been disclosed that defendant No.1 Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur before any date of alleged bainapatra was introduced or known to him. So, the identity of defendant No.1 only can be clarified by the Showkat Ali who is admittedly relative of plaintiff and the attesting witness of bainapatra who resides in the same holding but plaintiff side withheld that vital and important witness. Non examination of Shawkat Ali presumption would be if he would come and depose in the Court the facts would go against the plaintiff. 

 "Non examination of independent witnesses especially some of the close neighbour calls for presumption against the prosecution."
